events.title: Mini Update: Improved Visuals and Battle Effects
events.summary: We've updated the Duck Fest demo!This mini update focuses on brighter visuals and more satisfying battle presentation.What's new- Adjusted the colors of the title and battle screens- Added hand-drawn animation to the title logo- Added feather effects when cards are played- Refreshed the cut-ins shown when the flag changes hands- Improved round and match result presentations- Fixed issues with the tutorial and battle flowThe free demo is available now on Steam.Please give it a try and let us know

events.title: Major Tutorial Update + DuckFest Drills
events.summary: The Duck Fest demo has been updated to Ver. 0.6.0!This update significantly improves the tutorial and introduces the new DuckFest Drills.MAJOR TUTORIAL IMPROVEMENTSThe basic game rules and card effect lessons are now taught separately, making them easier to learn step by step.The first battle focuses on the victory conditions, card placement, capturing the flag, and the flow of turns and rounds.Dialogue, guidance, and presentation have also been revised to make your next objective clearer.DUCKFE
